requirement: Unrelated plugin toggle preserves Markdown block identity; changed/removed fence handler updates existing blocks.
upstream_citations: packages/tui/src/plugin/builtins.ts:17-35 (Merman, Latex registered unconditionally as builtin plugins)

repo doc-comment citations to upstream (not directly re-read this pass): packages/tui/src/plugin/markdown.ts:5-17, packages/tui/src/plugin/context.tsx:141-143, Markdown.ts:503-511 (set renderNode -> rebuild)
why_not_bounded: MD-007 cannot be a live-wired patch. The live flow `push_block_markdown` (crates/cli/src/native_view_chat.rs:2343) builds a FRESH `MarkdownFlow::new(...)` every call (:2357), calls set_content, renders, and drops it. It is a stateless per-frame repaint with no persistent block state, so it cannot express 'unrelated toggle preserves block identity'. The fence-handler registry `MarkdownPluginRegistry` (:468) and `MarkdownFlow::set_fence_handlers` (:681) have ONLY #[test] callers (native_markdown_flow.rs:2570-2605, 2642-2652). There is also no live plugin source (no /api/plugins route; `rg api/plugin` -> none) and no live plugin-toggle input, so the registry cannot even be populated with real registrations.

missing_seams.why_no_live_consumer: The live transcript painter reconstructs the whole block list every frame from a fresh MarkdownFlow. Block identity (the very thing MD-007 asserts across an unrelated plugin toggle) is discarded between frames; there is no long-lived flow object keyed by message/part.
missing_seams.required_producer: A monotonic, persistent MarkdownFlow per rendered message/part (or an epoch-keyed flow store) whose blocks survive an unrelated registry change, plus a renderer_epoch bump on effective-map change.

missing_seams.why_no_live_consumer: Both are fully implemented but reached only from #[test] (2570-2605, 2642-2652). No production code constructs a registry or binds it to a flow.
missing_seams.required_producer: A live plugin-registry producer that reflects the real installed/active plugin set (upstream builtins + user plugins) and a production caller of set_fence_handlers.

missing_seams.why_no_live_consumer: No daemon route exposes the active markdown code-block renderer set (upstream merman/latex plugin availability). The CLI cannot learn which handlers are registered.
missing_seams.required_producer: A daemon route (or an added field) reporting active markdown plugins / fence handlers so the CLI registry matches upstream builtins.ts.

missing_seams.why_no_live_consumer: There is no live toggle of an unrelated plugin that would exercise the block-identity contract; no input event or command reaches a registry.
missing_seams.required_producer: A live plugin enable/disable path (command palettes / Plugins page) wired to the registry, mirroring upstream plugin activation.

live_consumer: NONE. push_block_markdown is the only live consumer and it uses a fresh unregistered flow; MarkdownPluginRegistry/set_fence_handlers have only test callers.
focused_test_plan: No patch. Existing md_007-style tests (native_markdown_flow.rs:2570-2605) prove the registry model in isolation only; they do not prove a persistent live flow or a live plugin source, so they cannot satisfy the landability rule.
